_comment: Per-holding investment theses for the Thesis tab. PERSONAL use, not investment advice. These are concise, AI-generated STRUCTURAL views as of a Jan-2026 knowledge cutoff (durable bull case + key risk), NOT live news or current catalysts — the genuinely current read (how each name is actually doing) comes from the dashboard's live attribution and trend signals, which sit next to each card. Conviction is a subjective H/M/L PM read. Edit freely; this file is user-owned like trades.json. desc=what it is; thesis=why it may do well; risk=what to watch / what would change the view.

MSFT.US.desc: Enterprise software, Azure cloud, and Copilot AI.
MSFT.US.thesis: Azure and commercial Office compounding double-digits; the clearest enterprise monetiser of generative AI, with pricing power and a fortress balance sheet.
MSFT.US.risk: AI capex intensity compressing margins; cloud growth deceleration; lofty multiple.

DELL.US.desc: Servers, storage, PCs; large AI-server backlog.
DELL.US.thesis: AI-optimised server (ISG) orders ride the data-centre build-out; a PC refresh cycle is the kicker; cheap versus tech peers.
DELL.US.risk: Thin hardware margins; AI-server orders lumpy and fiercely competitive.

MRVL.US.desc: Data-centre custom silicon, optical and networking.
MRVL.US.thesis: Custom AI accelerators (ASICs) and optical interconnect are direct picks-and-shovels of the AI data-centre build-out.
MRVL.US.risk: Customer concentration; semis cyclicality; an AI-capex digestion pause.

INTC.US.desc: x86 CPUs and a nascent contract foundry.
INTC.US.thesis: Deep-value turnaround/optionality: foundry (IFS) plus onshoring/government support; re-rates if the process roadmap delivers.
INTC.US.risk: Execution on advanced nodes; foundry cash burn; share loss to AMD/ARM.

SOI.FR.desc: French maker of engineered SOI semiconductor substrates.
SOI.FR.thesis: Specialty substrates (RF-SOI, FD-SOI, SiC) levered to 5G/RF, automotive and power semis.
SOI.FR.risk: Smartphone/RF cyclicality; customer concentration; capex intensity.

981.HK.thesis: Domestic-substitution beneficiary as China builds a self-sufficient chip supply chain; capacity expansion plus policy support.
981.HK.risk: US export controls on advanced tools; mature-node overcapacity and pricing.

IGV.US.desc: iShares Expanded Tech-Software — US software basket.
IGV.US.thesis: Recurring-revenue, high-margin software re-rates as rates ease and AI features drive seat and usage growth.
IGV.US.risk: Rate-sensitive long-duration multiples; AI disruption to legacy SaaS.

LLY.US.thesis: Incretin/obesity franchise with a multi-year demand runway and deep pipeline; genuine pricing power.
LLY.US.risk: GLP-1 competition (Novo, oral entrants); supply constraints; rich valuation.

CPRX.US.thesis: Profitable, growing rare-disease franchise (Firdapse, Agamree); cash-generative small-cap with M&A optionality.
CPRX.US.risk: Reliance on few drugs; patent and competitive exposure.

OXY.US.desc: Occidental Petroleum — US shale E&P, chemicals, carbon capture.
OXY.US.thesis: Low-cost Permian barrels, ongoing deleveraging, and a carbon-capture option; Buffett-backed; leveraged to oil.
OXY.US.risk: Oil-price downside; debt load; capital-intensive CCS bets.

XLE.US.desc: Energy Select SPDR — US large-cap energy (XOM/CVX heavy).
XLE.US.thesis: Cash-returning integrated majors; high-dividend inflation and hard-asset hedge.

COPX.US.desc: Global X Copper Miners — global copper-mining equities.
COPX.US.thesis: Copper is the electrification metal — grid, EV and data-centre demand against structurally constrained supply.
COPX.US.risk: China demand; recession; mine-supply surprises; high beta to copper.

GDX.US.desc: VanEck Gold Miners — senior gold-producer equities.
GDX.US.thesis: Operating leverage to a firm gold price; a real-rate/USD hedge and geopolitical insurance sleeve.
GDX.US.risk: Gold price; cost inflation; operational/jurisdiction risk.

GDX.GB.desc: VanEck Gold Miners UCITS (LSE listing) — senior gold producers.
GDX.GB.thesis: Same as GDX.US: operating leverage to gold, a real-rate/USD hedge and geopolitical insurance.
GDX.GB.risk: Gold price; cost inflation; operational/jurisdiction risk.

REMX.US.desc: VanEck Rare Earth & Strategic Metals miners/processors.
REMX.US.thesis: Critical-minerals supply-security theme (magnets, defence, EV motors) as the West de-risks from China.
REMX.US.risk: Thin and volatile; China price actions; demand timing; concentration.

MOO.US.desc: VanEck Agribusiness — global ag inputs, equipment, processors.
MOO.US.thesis: Food-security and agricultural-input demand; defensive exposure to a structural need.
MOO.US.risk: Commodity and weather cycles; fertiliser pricing.

SGM.AU.thesis: Circular-economy and steel-decarbonisation (scrap-fed electric-arc) demand; leveraged to scrap spreads.
SGM.AU.risk: Scrap price/volume cyclicality; China steel; earnings volatility.

FLNC.US.desc: Fluence Energy — grid-scale battery storage systems and software.
FLNC.US.thesis: Pure-play on grid energy-storage build-out as renewables penetration rises; growing backlog.
FLNC.US.risk: Project-margin and execution risk; competition; path to durable profitability; policy.

TAN.US.desc: Invesco Solar — global solar value-chain ETF.
TAN.US.thesis: Solar-deployment growth plus rate relief re-rating beaten-down names.
TAN.US.risk: Rate sensitivity; China oversupply and pricing; subsidy/policy swings.

GRID.US.desc: First Trust NASDAQ Clean Edge Smart Grid — grid/electrification ETF.
GRID.US.thesis: Electrification and grid capex (data centres, EVs, renewables) — picks-and-shovels of the energy transition.

BNY.US.desc: Bank of New York Mellon — custody and asset-servicing bank.
BNY.US.thesis: Capital-light, fee-based custody franchise plus a net-interest tailwind; steady capital return.
BNY.US.risk: Rate cuts compress net interest income; fee-rate pressure.

SPHR.US.desc: Sphere Entertainment — the Las Vegas Sphere venue plus MSG Networks.
SPHR.US.thesis: A unique experiential-entertainment asset with scaling event economics and franchise/expansion optionality.

TSLA.US.desc: Tesla — EVs, energy storage, and FSD/robotics optionality.
TSLA.US.thesis: Auto cash-cow funding fast-growing energy storage, with an AI/autonomy and humanoid-robot optionality call.
TSLA.US.risk: Auto margin and demand; valuation hinges on unproven autonomy/robotics.

D05.thesis: High-ROE, well-capitalised SG bank with strong dividends and buybacks and a growing wealth franchise.
D05.risk: Rate cuts compress NIM; regional credit and property exposure.

O39.desc: OCBC — Singapore bank with Greater China/ASEAN reach and insurance.
O39.thesis: Cheap, well-capitalised SG bank; high dividend; ASEAN and bancassurance growth.
O39.risk: Rate cuts on NIM; Greater China property/credit exposure.

U11.desc: UOB — Singapore bank with deep ASEAN franchise.
U11.thesis: ASEAN regional-bank growth (Citi consumer integration) plus high dividend and strong capital.
U11.risk: Rate cuts on NIM; ASEAN credit cycle; integration costs.

ES3.desc: SPDR Straits Times Index ETF — SG large-cap index.
ES3.thesis: Low-cost SG blue-chip exposure: bank-heavy, high dividend yield, defensive value and portfolio ballast.
ES3.risk: Concentrated in the three banks; low structural growth.

G3B.desc: Nikko/AMOVA STI ETF (SGD) — SG large-cap index.
G3B.thesis: Same as ES3: low-cost, high-yield SG blue-chip index exposure.

GAB.desc: Nikko/AMOVA STI ETF (alt class) — SG large-cap index.
GAB.thesis: Same as ES3: low-cost, high-yield SG blue-chip index exposure.

AJBU.desc: Keppel DC REIT — Singapore data-centre REIT.
AJBU.thesis: Structural data-centre/AI capacity demand; resilient rents and a healthy distribution yield.
AJBU.risk: Rate sensitivity; tenant concentration; asset-value and financing cost.

J69U.desc: Frasers Centrepoint Trust — SG suburban-retail REIT.
J69U.thesis: Defensive suburban malls with high occupancy and stable distributions; a rate-cut beneficiary.

BN4.thesis: Transformation to a fee-based asset manager plus infrastructure and energy-transition exposure, with capital returns.
BN4.risk: Execution of the asset-light pivot; legacy offshore-marine tail; complexity.

5E2.desc: Seatrium — offshore & marine / rig and FPSO builder.
5E2.thesis: Offshore-energy capex recovery and a rebuilt orderbook (rigs, FPSOs, offshore wind).
5E2.risk: Execution and cost-overrun risk; lumpy orders; legacy provisions.

P52.desc: Pan-United — ready-mix concrete and cement (building materials).
P52.thesis: Singapore construction upcycle demand for concrete; steady cash and a dividend.

CJLU.desc: NetLink NBN Trust — owner of Singapore's fibre broadband network.
CJLU.thesis: Regulated, monopoly-like, bond-proxy cash flows with a steady distribution; a rate-sensitive yield anchor.
CJLU.risk: Rate sensitivity; regulatory review of allowed returns.

S58.desc: SATS — aviation gateway services and food solutions (incl. WFS).
S58.thesis: Air-travel and air-cargo recovery plus WFS scale in global cargo handling; operating leverage.
S58.risk: Travel/cargo cycle; WFS integration and debt.

992.HK.desc: Lenovo — global #1 PCs, plus servers and smart devices.
992.HK.thesis: PC refresh and AI-PC cycle plus a growing server/infrastructure (including AI) business; cheap with a dividend.
992.HK.risk: PC demand; thin margins; US-China geopolitics.

2338.HK.desc: Weichai Power H — China heavy-duty engines/powertrain and KION forklifts.
2338.HK.thesis: China truck-cycle recovery, natural-gas engine share gains, and data-centre genset demand.
2338.HK.risk: China industrial cycle; powertrain electrification transition.

3750.HK.desc: CATL H — the world's largest EV and storage battery maker.
3750.HK.thesis: Scale, cost and technology leadership in batteries, riding global EV and grid-storage growth.
3750.HK.risk: EV-demand pace; pricing/overcapacity; tariffs and geopolitics.

3173.HK.desc: Premia China New Economy ETF — China tech/consumer/healthcare.
3173.HK.thesis: Beaten-down China new-economy growth at low valuations, with policy-stimulus optionality.

YYY.thesis: Cheap China large-cap beta; a mean-reversion / stimulus play.
YYY.risk: China macro and policy; sentiment; FX.

3010.HK.desc: iShares Asia ex-Japan ETF — diversified Asia-ex-Japan equities.
3010.HK.thesis: Diversified Asia-ex-Japan growth (China, India, Korea, Taiwan, ASEAN) at reasonable valuations.
3010.HK.risk: Heavy China weight; EM and FX risk.

ICU.desc: Asia ex-Japan climate/transition-tilted equity ETF (USD, SGX).
ICU.thesis: Asia-ex-Japan equity with a climate-transition tilt — regional growth plus the decarbonisation theme.
ICU.risk: China/EM exposure; thematic tracking and liquidity.

1615.JP.desc: TOPIX Banks ETF — Japanese bank sector.
1615.JP.thesis: BOJ normalisation and positive rates restore Japanese bank net-interest margins; governance reform drives capital returns.
1615.JP.risk: A reversal in the BOJ rate path; JGB/credit shocks; JPY.

4004.JP.desc: Resonac Holdings — Japanese chemicals and semiconductor materials.
4004.JP.thesis: Leader in back-end/advanced-packaging semiconductor materials, levered to AI chip packaging, with restructuring upside.

ARGT.US.desc: Global X MSCI Argentina — Argentine equity ETF.
ARGT.US.thesis: Reform and macro-stabilisation re-rating Argentine assets from deeply depressed levels.
ARGT.US.risk: Political/policy reversal; FX and inflation; very high volatility.

D07.desc: SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (USD, SGX) — US blue-chips.
D07.thesis: Core US large-cap blue-chip beta; quality/value tilt and portfolio ballast.

S27.desc: SPDR S&P 500 ETF (USD, SGX) — US large-cap index.
S27.thesis: Core US large-cap beta — broad earnings growth and global leadership.
S27.risk: US valuation and mega-cap concentration; rates.
